benchmarks.placeholder: Here you will start and compare evaluation runs. It arrives in a later release.

sets.title: Question sets
sets.placeholder: Here you will review, edit and import question sets. It arrives in a later release.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not exist in the app.

error.title: Something went wrong

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the account that the engine's administrator gave you.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {{seconds}} s and try again.
login.rateLimitedNoWait: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
login.unavailable: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.

change.title: Change your password
change.description: Your password is temporary. Choose a new one to continue.
change.hint: At least {{min}} characters and different from your username.
change.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
change.failed: The password could not be changed. Try again.

errors.sameAsUsername: It cannot be the same as your username.
errors.sameAsCurrent: It must be different from the current one.

menu.label: {{name}}'s account
menu.logoutFailed: Could not sign out. Try again.

ask.intro: Ask a question about the papers in the corpus. The answer cites its sources: click a citation to read the paper at that page. Questions and answers stay in this tab and are not saved on the server.

form.label: Your question
form.placeholder: For example: What limits T1 in transmons?
form.hint: Press Ctrl+Enter to send. At most {{max}} characters.
form.blank: Write a question to send it.
form.busy: A question is being answered. Wait for it or cancel it to send another.

options.title: Options
options.description: They apply to the questions you send until you reset them. Each option can also stay on the server's own setting.

useIndex.label: Search with the index
useIndex.help: Off: the answering model looks through the whole corpus itself, which is slow.

bm25.label: Keyword matching
bm25.help: When keyword matching joins the vector search.

wholeBlocks.label: Complete equations and tables
wholeBlocks.help: Complete the equation, code block or table that a passage cuts.

warming.title: The engine is starting
warming.body: Questions can be sent in a few seconds.

unavailable.title: The engine reports a problem
unavailable.body: {{reason}} You can still send a question: the cause may already be fixed.
unavailable.noReason: You can still send a question: the cause may already be fixed.

unreachable.title: The service cannot be reached
unreachable.body: Check that the API is running. Questions will fail until it answers.

answer.title: Answer
answer.timings: Searched in {{retrieve}} s, answered in {{answer}} s ({{wall}} s in all).
answer.timingsNoSearch: Answered in {{answer}} s, without the index.
answer.openCitation: Open the paper at this citation

contexts.title: What the model read
contexts.none: No passages came with this answer.

title.503: The service cannot answer right now
title.502: A model server returned an error

failure.network: The connection to the service was lost while waiting for the answer.
failure.lost: The service no longer has this question. It keeps them for 30 minutes.
failure.malformed: The service sent something this page does not understand.

history.title: This session
history.note: Kept in this tab only. Closing the tab or signing out erases them.

source.notFound: This page is not in the paper.
source.ambiguous: That short id names more than one paper.
source.error: The page could not be loaded.

circuits.intro: Paste the code of a circuit from a paper, see the gates the reader found, simulate it and check it against a state, a unitary or another circuit. Nothing here leaves your machines.

input.title: Circuit
input.description: Paste LaTeX (quantikz, Qcircuit, yquant or tikz-cd) or a circuit/1 document.
input.latexHint: The body of one code block. The reader lists every gate it understands and every part it does not. Press Ctrl+Enter to read.
input.jsonHint: Used as written: wires are numbered from 1, top to bottom. A key written twice is refused. Press Ctrl+Enter to read.

reading.title: Gate list

explain.parsed: Every part of the drawing was understood.
explain.partial: Some parts of the drawing were not understood. The simulator refuses a circuit with unread parts.
explain.unparsed: No circuit was found in this text.

reading.wiresPlain: Wires: {{count}}, numbered from 1 at the top.
reading.captionOne: Gates of circuit {{n}}, left to right
reading.captionLeft: Circuit {{n}}, left side of the equality
reading.unreadBody: These parts of the drawing were not understood, so the circuit cannot be simulated until they are removed or rewritten.
reading.nothing: There is no circuit to show.

run.title: Simulate
run.description: The final state and the outcome probabilities, up to 12 wires.
run.inputHint: A basis label such as 010 (wire 1 first) or a list of amplitudes such as [0, 1]. Empty means all wires in 0.
run.valuesHint: One per line, name = value. A value is a number or an angle such as \pi/2.
run.unitary: Also show the unitary (up to 8 wires)

check.title: Check
check.description: Is the circuit equal to a target, up to a global phase?

hint.state: A basis label such as 11 or a list of amplitudes of norm 1, for example [0.7071, 0, 0, 0.7071].
hint.unitary: A square matrix as a list of rows. Each entry is a number or a pair [re, im].
hint.circuit: LaTeX of one circuit, or a circuit/1 document starting with {.

check.drawnHint: Compares the two sides of the equality drawn in the circuit, left against right.
check.drawnNone: The circuit read has no equality drawn in it.

result.refusedBody: The simulator did not run this circuit, so there is no result. These are its reasons.
result.symbolicBody: The circuit has symbols with no value: {{names}}. Give each a value and simulate again.
result.addNames: Add the names to the values
result.stateCaption: Final state (wires: {{wires}}). Wire 1 is the most significant bit.
result.noState: The state is not listed for a circuit of this size.
result.corner: Showing the top left {{shown}} by {{shown}} of {{size}} by {{size}}.
result.seeConventions: See the conventions and the gate table

live.equal: Check finished: equal up to global phase.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.ofResult: As stated in the last result.
conventions.ofSimulator: What the simulator assumes. Every result repeats them.
conventions.unavailable: The conventions could not be loaded.
conventions.limits: The simulator itself takes up to {{statevector}} wires for a state, {{unitary}} for a unitary and {{ops}} operations.
conventions.apiCaps: This screen is for small circuits: up to 12 wires, or 8 for a unitary or for a comparison of two circuits. For larger ones use the quantum-sim command line.
conventions.gateTableCaption: Gates the simulator knows, by name

problem.unprocessable: The circuit could not be processed
problem.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this
problem.malformed: The server's answer could not be read

invalidJson.title: Not valid JSON
invalidJson.detail: The text is not valid JSON. Check the commas and the brackets.

duplicateKey.title: A key is written twice
duplicateKey.detail: The key "{{key}}" appears twice in one object. The text does not say which value is meant, so it is refused.

notACircuit.title: Not a circuit/1 document
notACircuit.detail: A circuit/1 document needs a number of wires and a list of parts.

notRead.title: Read the circuit first
notRead.detail: Press Read circuit, then simulate or check.

badValues.title: A parameter value is not valid
badValues.detail: Line {{line}} ({{name}}): write name = value, once per name.

badState.title: The state is not valid
badState.detail: Write a basis label such as 010, or a list of amplitudes such as [0, 1].

badUnitary.title: The unitary is not valid
badUnitary.detail: Write a matrix as a list of rows, for example [[0, 1], [1, 0]].

emptyTarget.title: No target given
emptyTarget.detail: Write what to compare the circuit with.

secondUnread.title: The second circuit was not read
secondUnread.detail: No circuit was found in the second text.

secondMany.title: More than one circuit in the second text
secondMany.detail: The second text holds {{count}} circuits. Keep one.

network.title: The server could not be reached
network.detail: Check the connection and try again.
